'''Blee'starn''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. 

It was located on an island in the [[Rhyde'vak]] [[ocean/Legends|ocean]] in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] eastern hemisphere.
